name: add_tests_php_password_policy
description: Asks the model to write PHPUnit tests for a password-strength classifier; mutation-checked
prompts: Password::strength(string $p): string in src/Password.php (already correct - do not modify it) classifies a password: "weak" if it is shorter than 8 characters; otherwise "strong" if it contains a lowercase letter AND an uppercase letter AND a digit; otherwise "medium". Write PHPUnit tests at exactly tests/PasswordTest.php (class PasswordTest extends PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase) with at least 4 test methods using assertSame that pin: a short password (< 8 chars, even if it has all classes) is "weak"; an 8+ char password with lower+upper+digit is "strong"; an 8+ char password missing a class is "medium"; and one more boundary of your choice. Begin the file with `require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/Password.php';`.

setup_files.src/Password.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class Password
{
    public static function strength(string $p): string
    {
        if (strlen($p) < 8) {
            return "weak";
        }
        $hasLower = preg_match('/[a-z]/', $p) === 1;
        $hasUpper = preg_match('/[A-Z]/', $p) === 1;
        $hasDigit = preg_match('/[0-9]/', $p) === 1;
        if ($hasLower && $hasUpper && $hasDigit) {
            return "strong";
        }
        return "medium";
    }
}

test_setup_files.mutation_check.php:
<?php
$impl = "src/Password.php";
$testCmd = "phpunit tests/PasswordTest.php";
$enc = [["c3RybGVuKCRwKSA8IDg=", "c3RybGVuKCRwKSA8IDY="], ["JGhhc0xvd2VyICYmICRoYXNVcHBlciAmJiAkaGFzRGlnaXQ=", "JGhhc0xvd2VyIHx8ICRoYXNVcHBlciB8fCAkaGFzRGlnaXQ="], ["ICAgICAgICAgICAgcmV0dXJuICJzdHJvbmciOw==", "ICAgICAgICAgICAgcmV0dXJuICJtZWRpdW0iOw=="]];
$mutants = array_map(fn($p) => [base64_decode($p[0]), base64_decode($p[1])], $enc);
$src = file_get_contents($impl);
foreach ($mutants as [$old, $new]) {
    if (substr_count($src, $old) !== 1) {
        fwrite(STDERR, "protected impl modified (anchor not found exactly once)\n");
        exit(2);
    }
}
function run($cmd) { $rc = 0; passthru($cmd, $rc); return $rc; }
if (run($testCmd) !== 0) { fwrite(STDERR, "model tests FAILED on the correct impl\n"); exit(1); }
$exit = 0;
foreach ($mutants as $i => [$old, $new]) {
    file_put_contents($impl, str_replace($old, $new, $src));
    if (run($testCmd) === 0) {
        fwrite(STDERR, "mutation " . ($i + 1) . " SURVIVED\n");
        $exit = 1;
    }
    file_put_contents($impl, $src);
}
if ($exit === 0) { echo "PASS (killed " . count($mutants) . " mutants)\n"; }
exit($exit);

reference_solution.tests/PasswordTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/Password.php';

final class PasswordTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testShortIsWeak(): void
    {
        // 7 chars, has all classes, but too short
        $this->assertSame("weak", \App\Password::strength("Abc123!"));
    }

    public function testAllClassesIsStrong(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame("strong", \App\Password::strength("Abcd1234"));
    }

    public function testMissingUpperIsMedium(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame("medium", \App\Password::strength("abcd1234"));
    }

    public function testOnlyLettersIsMedium(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame("medium", \App\Password::strength("abcdefgh"));
    }
}

<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/Password.php';

final class PasswordTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testReturnsString(): void
    {
        $this->assertIsString(\App\Password::strength("Abcd1234"));
    }

    public function testKnownValues(): void
    {
        $this->assertContains(\App\Password::strength("Abcd1234"), ["weak", "medium", "strong"]);
    }

    public function testShortNotEmpty(): void
    {
        $this->assertNotEmpty(\App\Password::strength("abc"));
    }

    public function testAnother(): void
    {
        $this->assertIsString(\App\Password::strength("xyz"));
    }
}
